question: Which of the following four groups of line segments (unit: cm) can form a proportion (the order may be rearranged)?
solution: For proportional line segments, the product of the longest and shortest must equal the product of the other two: \(2\times6=12=3\times4\), so \(2:3=4:6\) holds. None of the other groups satisfies this condition.
